guard: the ledger's delegation walk applies the shared token rule, under which run carries the spawn set, and refuses a scope token the mesh does not read even when the parent lists it
why: A run holder reaches the whole spawn set, so it may hand on spawn. L1 puts back plain set
inclusion, which refuses that delegation. L2 drops the delegable-token check, so a parent that
lists an arbitrary token hands it on.

mutations.name: L1 plain set inclusion for scope
mutations.find: const overScope = child.scope.filter((s) => !((DELEGABLE_SCOPE.has(s) || ROLE_SCOPE.test(s)) && capabilityWithin(parent.scope, s)));
mutations.expectRed: scope [spawn] delegates within a [run] spawner (run carries the spawn set)

mutations.name: L2 drop the delegable-token check
mutations.find: const overScope = child.scope.filter((s) => !((DELEGABLE_SCOPE.has(s) || ROLE_SCOPE.test(s)) && capabilityWithin(parent.scope, s)));
mutations.expectRed: an unknown token is refused even when the parent lists it
